description: A district curriculum director must approve the operating plan for a six-week sixth-grade digital reading-intervention pilot, including the program, weekly session frequency, and student-data controls, with input from a literacy coach and the district privacy liaison.

shared_context.S1: The district is preparing a six-week digital reading-intervention pilot for sixth-grade students at three middle schools.
shared_context.S2: The sixth-grade intervention block meets three times each week.
shared_context.S3: Program NorthStar costs $18 per student, while Program Trail costs $20 per student; both programs have completed the district's instructional-evidence review.
shared_context.S4: The curriculum director has final authority to approve the pilot's program, implementation schedule, and data controls.
shared_context.S5: As part of the routine curriculum approval meeting, the curriculum director asks the literacy coach and privacy liaison to report any instructional or data-governance requirements before the plan is finalized.
shared_context.S6: The approval agenda gives each specialist an uninterrupted report before the curriculum director records the final approval decision.

PF1.text: The finalized implementation guide for NorthStar requires five student sessions per week for fidelity, which cannot fit the three-session intervention block; Program Trail's approved implementation design requires exactly three sessions per week. Ms. Nair completed the comparison this week, but the procurement summary still lists only the prices and has not been updated.

PF2.text: The executed privacy addendum for Program Trail requires student-data sharing to be disabled and requires deletion of pilot data within exactly 30 days after the pilot ends. Mr. Ortiz received the signed addendum yesterday, but the procurement summary still contains the vendor's earlier standard retention language.

acceptance_conditions: Program Trail must be selected because its implementation design fits the intervention block.
The pilot must run exactly three sessions per week.
Pilot data must be deleted exactly 30 days after the pilot ends.
The session-fidelity comparison or Trail's three-session requirement must be documented in a commitment.
The privacy addendum's sharing-disabled or 30-day-deletion requirements must be documented in a commitment.
The privacy addendum must be cited after being revealed by its owner.

content_checks.C5: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and any('three sessions per week' in c['detail'] or 'three-session-per-week' in c['detail'] or 'Trail requires exactly three sessions per week' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(('student-data sharing' in c['detail'] and 'disabled' in c['detail']) or ('data sharing' in c['detail'] and 'disabled' in c['detail']) or ('30 days' in c['detail'] and ('delet' in c['detail'] or 'retention' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The five-session NorthStar requirement conflicts with the three-session block, so using PF1 changes the program to Trail, fixes the schedule at exactly three sessions per week, and supplies the specific Trail session-frequency requirement for the documentation commitment.

The signed Trail addendum changes data deletion to exactly 30 days and requires sharing to be disabled, while supplying the specific privacy requirements for the documentation commitment and citation.
